title: Inside the Narrative Laboratory
use_cases: Use when modeling plotlines as dynamic systems
Implement when mapping character emotional arcs to physical analogies
Configure when ensuring consistency of narrative rules across scenes
Use when analyzing speculative stories for coherence
Implement when teaching storytelling techniques via physics metaphors
content:
Imagine a research facility where Borges writes the floor plan, Octavia Butler sets the safety protocols, and the walls flicker like a malfunctioning holodeck. In this metaphorical lab, story physics replace the physics we know.

Every great speculative tale—from Arrival to The Fifth Season to Everything Everywhere All at Once– runs experiments with altered reality. Plotlines behave like charged particles. Characters follow emotional trajectories that act like gravitational fields. Audiences sense when a world’s rules are working, even if those rules involve time dilation caused by grief or universes stitched together with memory.

Readers don’t need to consciously decode a magic system or futuristic technology. They just need the system to behave consistently.

This is where narrative physics begins.
